hero.webp.prompt: Create a premium photorealistic editorial industrial photograph for a cable-management manufacturer's website. Wide landscape 3:2 composition. Close view along multiple brushed galvanized steel perforated cable trays and cable ladders installed in a clean large industrial interior, perspective receding toward the upper right. Crisp realistic metal perforations, precise fasteners, calm cool grey palette, warm natural daylight, restrained architectural photography, tactile real metal detail, slightly dark background. No people, no logos, no text, no watermark, no gradients or graphic overlays. This is a generic illustrative industrial scene, not a real company facility. Compose subject on right and center; the photograph will be shown in its own rectangular panel, not behind text. Save image to workspace if supported.

hero-secondary.webp.prompt: Photorealistic architectural industrial editorial photograph, landscape 3:2. Long precision galvanized steel cable ladder and perforated cable tray routing overhead through a modern clean large industrial building, diagonal perspective into depth, wide composition, brushed silver metal, realistic fastening and supporting struts, soft daylight and deep neutral shadows. No people, no text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no charts, no graphic overlays. Generic illustrative industrial environment, not any specific company's actual factory. The LEFT HALF should be quiet darker industrial space with low visual clutter for a later website text overlay, cable tray structure strongest on the RIGHT. Premium restrained international engineering photography. Entire image sharp; blur will be applied in CSS.
